scripts.dev: concurrently --names server,web --prefix-colors blue,green "npm run -w @hyperidle/remote-server dev" "npm run -w @hyperidle/core-ui dev"
scripts.dev:desktop: concurrently --names web,desktop --prefix-colors green,blue "npm run -w @hyperidle/core-ui dev" "npm run -w @hyperidle/desktop dev"
scripts.build:desktop: npm run -w @hyperidle/core-ui build && npm run -w @hyperidle/desktop build
scripts.test:all: npm run test:full && npm run test:integration
scripts.lint: biome check . --error-on-warnings --max-diagnostics=none && npx eslint . --max-warnings=0 && npm run lint:design-css && npx tsx tools/governance/src/governance-lint.ts --fixtures && npx tsx tools/governance/src/governance-lint.ts --attacks && npx tsx tools/governance/src/governance-lint.ts
scripts.verify: npm run check && npm run lint && npm run knip && npm run knip:production && npm run deps:check && npm run mock-inventory:check && npm run build && npm run -w @hyperidle/desktop build
scripts.verify:release: npm run verify && npm run test:full && npm run test:integration && npm run test:e2e
scripts.verify:quick: npm run check && npm run lint && npm run knip && npm run knip:production && npm run deps:check
scripts.knip:production: npx knip --include files && npx knip --production --include files,dependencies,unlisted,binaries --preprocessor ./tools/repo-gates/src/knip-production-test-files.mjs
